page.overview:
Who is Bushido?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Bushido was Ninja Force figure #6 in the 1993 series of A Real American Hero toys. ---- Appearance: light blue and white Samurai helmet with white horns; light blue shirt with white straps and gloves; orange details on straps; light blue pants fading to white, with white belt and boots

Accessories: white "Slice" knife; two "Banzai" dueling knives; white "Dojo" sword; white "'92 Storm Shadow" sword; white "Dojo" sickle (without string or counterweight); white "Dice" battle axe; white figure stand.

Variations: Early packaging described an incorrect ninja move and was soon corrected. ---- YoJoe.com page/Filecard
